stories.title: Head of north Wales health board quits for English NHS trust
stories.summary: The boss of the health board that runs Wrexham Maelor Hospital and NHS services across Flintshire is leaving for a job in England. Carol Shillabeer, chief executive of Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board, will start as chief executive of Lancashire and South Cumbria NHS Foundation Trust early in the new year. stories.title: Bird keepers across Wales must follow new bird flu rules from Monday
stories.summary: Anyone in Wales who keeps chickens, ducks, geese or other birds must follow new rules to stop the spread of bird flu from midday on Monday 16 November, however few birds they have. stories.title: Flintshire Cabinet accused of shelving school transport review until after election
stories.summary: The motion says a working group's recommendations missed an October deadline because Cabinet would not put them out to consultation.

stories.title: Flintshire Bridge back open following earlier incident
stories.summary: Update: The bridge has now reopened. Earlier report: The Flintshire Bridge is closed in both directions because of an incident on the A548 in Connah’s Quay, police have said. stories.title: Rocks thrown at houses and passing cars, Penyffordd councillor says
stories.summary: Rocks were thrown at houses, parked cars and passing traffic on Chester Road in Penyffordd, a local councillor has said. Cllr Roy Wakelam (Penyffordd, Independent) said in a post on Facebook that several teenagers were hammering on doors on the Millstone View estate and running off at about 9.30pm.
